question: How do I initialize a Fern folder with an OpenAPI specification from a web-hosted file?
ground_truth: To initialize a Fern folder with an OpenAPI specification from a web-hosted file, run the command: `fern init --openapi https://api.example.com/openapi.yml --organization <YourOrganization>`. This command accepts both JSON and YML formats for OpenAPI specifications. The --organization flag is required to successfully generate your SDK.

metadata.cited_context: Initialize the fern folder using your OpenAPI Specification. Fern can handle both JSON and YML formats for OpenAPI specifications and the `--openapi` flag accepts either format, so you can use whichever format your API spec is available in. Run one of the following commands based on your spec's location: Web-hosted file: `fern init --openapi https://api.example.com/openapi.yml --organization <YourOrganization>`. `--organization <YourOrganization>` configures your organization name in `fern.config.json`. This is required in order to successfully generate your SDK.
